ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, yeah, so many Jones. What else? Quite a number of Jones playing music. No, it's not related to me. Mm-hmm. I know Jones, I know playing music. It's me and my son, Eugene.

Richard M. was a composer and a piano player. He wrote this troubling mind. Who's that? Richard M. Jones, my knee they called me. Yeah. But he was gone, I guess he left shortly after you were born. Yeah, I guess so. Not too long after you were born. And he snuck around Donaldsonville. You get curious about those things. Yes.
